'''Ranger Protectors''' are high elven guards located at various locations occupied by the [[Silvermoon Remnant]]. They guard the [[Farstrider Lodge]] in [[Loch Modan]], [[Little Silvermoon]] in [[Stormwind City]], and a handful are present in the high elf capital of [[Alah'Thalas]] below the [[Golden Dawn Institute]] with [[Damilara Sunsorrow]]. Two Ranger Protectors are also present in [[Tirisfal Glades]], guarding [[Scryer Lordal Thas'alah]].
